subject.title: [Bug]: Agent heartbeat routes to wrong agent's session instead of its own

question: Should maintainers require a live current-main reproduction of the global-scope secondary-agent heartbeat route before queueing a fix PR?
rationale: Source inspection and reporter evidence make the issue credible, but the likely fix touches compatibility-sensitive global session/store routing and the issue is already labeled for maintainer review and live repro.

options.title: Run live repro first
options.body: Reproduce the WSL2 or Docker `global` plus `per-channel-peer` case on current main, then queue a narrow fix with regression coverage against the confirmed path.

options.title: Queue source-level fix now
options.body: Accept the source evidence as enough and let a repair PR attempt a focused fix plus tests without live proof first.

options.title: Fold into session-routing review
options.body: Keep this issue open but defer implementation until adjacent global-session and dmScope routing behavior can be reviewed together.

recommendation.title: Run live repro first
recommendation.body: Reproduce the WSL2 or Docker `global` plus `per-channel-peer` case on current main, then queue a narrow fix with regression coverage against the confirmed path.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame and recent history make this the strongest available routing owner for deciding proof sufficiency.
